import base64,io,tarfile,subprocess;D='/content/DogBreed-PhD-Research';tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(base64.b64decode('')),mode='r:xz').extractall(D,filter='data');r=subprocess.run(f'cd {D} && pip install -q --no-deps -e . && python -m pytest -q tests 2>&1 | tail -2',shell=True,capture_output=True,text=True);print('BUNDLE OK 14 files');print(r.stdout[-800:],r.stderr[-800:])
